name: arcade-pixel

frames.best_why: Big GAME OV letters, scrolling score, INSERT COIN and the sprites are all readable together.

tagline: Pixel-art arcade text and sprites scroll, type and blink with CRT glow.
summary: A black arcade screen draws messages in a chunky 5x7 pixel font on canvas, with space-invader sprites, typing and marquee animations, phosphor glow, scanlines and a faint CRT flicker.
appearance: A black rounded panel holding pixel art: three small glowing sprites along the top, a green alien, a pink cat and a yellow heart, then large pink blocky letters, a line of cyan scrolling text and white INSERT COIN beneath.
behaviour: The big message types itself out letter by letter with a white flash on each new glyph, the cyan score line slides sideways continuously, and INSERT COIN blinks on and off over scanlines and a soft flicker.
demo_content: The words GAME OVER, a HIGH SCORE 098400 PLAYER 1 ticker and INSERT COIN, plus alien and heart sprites.
search_phrases: old arcade machine screen for web
use_when: A game, event or playful landing page wants the look of an old arcade screen with animated pixel text.
avoid_when: Canvas text is not selectable or searchable, and everything is sized in pixel cells rather than CSS type.
customise: Text or a sprite grid, palette, pixel size, gap, columns, animation, speed, loop, glow, scanlines and CRT are all props. The 5x7 font and built-in sprites are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A small 2D canvas repaints each frame for the marquee and blink, but pauses offscreen.

a11y.note: The message is exposed as hidden text and reduced motion freezes it, but the canvas art itself is aria-hidden.

issues: Several effects run at once, so the big title competes with the score ticker and blinking line.
polish_why: Authentic arcade look with a custom pixel font and CRT layers; several effects at once feel busy.
